csv_project_name: Developer for Blue Ramp Parking Structure
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Appleton Department of Community Development invites proposals from experienced developers for mixed use and/or housing development for parcel #31-2- 0272-00 located on the southeast corner of W Washington Street and N Appleton Street. This parcel is currently owned by the City of Appleton, is the former location of the Blue Ramp parking structure and, as such, is an asset of the City s Parking Utility. It is well-positioned within Tax Increment District #11. The City intends to sell the site to a developer. This is a rare opportunity to develop a shovel ready property in the heart of Appleton s downtown.
